sql:
SELECT
  l.ordered_on AS day,
  l.store_no,
  l.item_no,
  'total' AS series,
  l.sales_dollars AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE s.county_name = 'LINN'
  AND l.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no
    FROM sales.item i
    JOIN sales.item h ON h.item_no = i.family_item_no
    WHERE h.item_desc ILIKE '%FIREBALL%'
  )
  AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
assumptions: Fireball means every product of the Fireball brand (all sizes, flavors like Blazin Apple and Torch'd Vanilla, and special packaging), matched on the current family item description containing FIREBALL.
Linn County is identified by the store's county (sales.store.county_name), not city.
Data runs through 2026-08-31, so the current quarter in progress is Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep); 'next quarter' means the next full calendar quarter, Q4 2026 (Oct-Dec), which is the single quarter requested.
Revenue means sales_dollars from invoice lines.
One total series is reported, no breakout.
title: Fireball Revenue Forecast - Linn County, Next Quarter (Q4 2026)
product: Fireball (all Fireball-branded products: Cinnamon Whiskey, Blazin Apple, Torch'd Vanilla, all sizes and packs)

sql:

       l.store_no AS store_no,
       l.item_no AS item_no,
       'total' AS series,
       l.sales_bottles AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
WHERE l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
  AND l.item_no IN (
      SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE category_current = '1081200'
  )
assumptions: "Cream liqueur" is read as the Cream Liqueurs category (category_current = 1081200), using each product's current category so renumbered items are included.
"For the holidays" is read as through December 31, 2026.
Data runs through August 31, 2026, so the forecast horizon is the 4 months September through December 2026.
No place or breakout restriction: all Iowa stores combined, single total series.
Measure is bottles ordered (sales_bottles), which already accounts for mini-pack bottle counts.
title: Cream Liqueur Bottle Demand Forecast Through Holidays 2026

sql:
SELECT il.ordered_on AS day, il.store_no, il.item_no, 'total' AS series, il.sales_dollars AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.item i ON i.item_no = il.item_no
JOIN sales.category c ON c.category_code = i.category_current
WHERE c.category_name ILIKE '%VODKA%'
  AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
assumptions: Vodka means all products in categories whose current name contains VODKA (American Vodkas, American Flavored Vodka, Imported Vodkas, Imported Flavored Vodka); no liqueur or RTD vodka-based categories exist so none are excluded.
Grain not specified beyond 'next year', so reporting by month for 12 months ahead, starting September 2026 (first month after the data ends August 31, 2026) through August 2027.
Measure is sales dollars (sales_dollars) as requested.
Place is statewide Iowa, all stores.
title: Iowa Vodka Sales Forecast - Next Year
product: Vodka (all categories: American, American Flavored, Imported, Imported Flavored)
